previous_description: Stored computation logic that executes within the data store engine. Paradigm-neutral: covers SQL functions and procedures, MongoDB aggregation pipelines, Redis Lua scripts, Cassandra UDFs, Neo4j stored procedures, Elasticsearch ingest pipelines, time-series continuous queries, and DynamoDB Lambda triggers.
definition: A named unit of executable logic that is deployed into and executed by the data store engine itself, such as an SQL function, procedure or package, a Redis Lua script or function, a Cassandra UDF/UDA, a Neo4j procedure, an Elasticsearch ingest pipeline or Painless script, or a scheduled time-series task. It is invoked by name, by an event handler, or on a schedule, rather than shipped as a query text by application code.

distinguish_from.when: the element is the binding that fires on a data-change event (CREATE TRIGGER, a change-stream subscription, a keyspace notification listener), not the routine body that the binding calls
the stored query is exposed as a readable derived collection (CREATE VIEW, a materialized view, a continuous aggregate, a search alias) that clients select from, rather than a routine they invoke
the query or aggregation pipeline is built and sent ad hoc by repository/DAO code on each call and is never registered in the engine
the integrity check is a declarative constraint (CHECK, NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY, JSON Schema validator, strict mapping) rather than procedural code

standard_reference: ISO/IEC 9075-2 SQL-invoked routines (CREATE FUNCTION / CREATE PROCEDURE) and ISO/IEC 9075-4 SQL/PSM (Persistent Stored Modules)
code_evidence: A migration or schema file containing CREATE [OR REPLACE] FUNCTION, CREATE PROCEDURE or CREATE PACKAGE with a LANGUAGE clause (plpgsql, tsql, java) and a routine body, e.g. a $$-delimited block
A .lua script file loaded with SCRIPT LOAD and called via EVALSHA, or registered with redis.register_function / ioredis defineCommand

Application code calling a routine by name (JDBC CallableStatement '{call ...}', Python cursor.callproc, Spring @Procedure, Npgsql CommandType.StoredProcedure), or engine config such as PUT _ingest/pipeline/<name> or an InfluxDB task with 'option task = {every: ...}'
notes: LAMBDA and language EXTERNAL contradict 'executes within the engine'. DynamoDB Lambda triggers are better modelled as an eventhandler bound to external application code. CONTINUOUS_QUERY overlaps view CONTINUOUS_AGGREGATE and retentionpolicy DOWNSAMPLE. PROCEDURE and STORED_PROCEDURE duplicate each other. A parameters/signature attribute is missing. The 'migrates' relationship to collection is unclear.
